summary.headline: Natures of the Zodiac Signs
summary.text: Chapter III classifies the twelve zodiac signs by elemental nature, hotness and coldness, masculinity and femininity, diurnality and nocturnality, and movable, fixed, or bicorporeal quality, with their degree divisions and symbols. Chapter IV begins on the revolutions of years, following discussion of eclipses and universal celestial significations.
